title: Droid
tagline: An AI Agent which is capable of doing every onchain task on Arbitrum and Arbitrum Sepolia blockchain just by giving prompt
description:
An AI Agent which is capable of doing every onchain task on Arbitrum and Arbitrum Sepolia blockchain just by giving prompt.
